summary: Implemented secure Payment Admin Workspace backend for Treasury Ops integrating PaymentCore GraphQL and Payment Rail REST APIs via Gateway with mTLS+OAuth2, RBAC enforcement, and audit logging (Kafka+S3). Includes routes for merchant search, settlement timeline, refund trigger, payout approval, anomaly alerts, and audit report export.

code_files.description: Handles merchant and payment batch search via PaymentCore GraphQL and Payment Rail REST APIs.
Retrieves settlement timeline and anomaly alerts for payment batches.
Manages refund and approval actions via Payment Actions and Payment Rail APIs.
Enforces RBAC access control for OpsAnalyst, Manager, and Auditor roles.
Utility for emitting audit logs to Kafka and archiving to S3.
